title: EnderSyrup
description:
A fun minecraft mod that adds two new items!
Ender Syrup, as the name suggests, and Ender Ash, which is made from an ender pearl and used to make the syrup!
body:
**Why use an ender pearl once when you can do that triple the amount?**

Introducting **Ender Syrup**, which obviously turns those pearly enders into a drink that makes u teleport! ~~might be a fancy chorus fruit~~ **but IT'S FUN!**
1 pearl = 9 Ender Ash
3 Ender Ash = 1 Ender Syrup

**_One pearl for three bottles of the lovely exilir!_**
